svg.aria-label: Lines in the punctured plane and the label read by the line integral R_X, in the two charts
svg.title: Lines in the punctured plane and the label read by the line integral R_X, in the two charts
svg.text: The label read by the integrand of R_X along lines a x + b y = τ² (here τ² = 1, (a, b) = (cos α, sin α))
Along each line: outer strip, its label in U_X, {x, −x′}₂; inner strip, its label in U_Y, {x, b y}₂. Each has a gap where its chart ends.
The label read at the point of tangency (cos α, sin α), as the line turns once:
the choice jumps here: x′ = 0, outside U_X, and U_Y does not reach the point (−1, 0)
shaded: x < 0, y < 0, where the labels in the two charts differ; dots: the panels above
